title: Invariant complements force a squarefree minimum polynomial
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], $V$ a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and $T:V\to V$ a $K$-linear map. Let $m_T\in K[X]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be the monic polynomial of least degree annihilating $T$, with $m_T=1$ if $V=0$. If every $T$-invariant subspace $U$ has a $T$-invariant complement $U\prime$ with $V=U\oplus U\prime$, then $m_T$ is squarefree: $m_T\ne0$ and no square of a nonconstant polynomial divides $m_T$.
